messages:
Priya (AE): kicking off Ironbridge POC now — they want to migrate from BlueGate API to our endpoints. 2-week POC. primary asks: prompt parity, webhook semantics, pricing for a committed monthly volume, and security questionnaire answers. tagging SEs for parity checklist.

Alex (Solutions Eng): noted. biggest risks: function-calling semantics + streaming vs non-streaming differences. we usually recommend a tiny shim for their client to map fields.

Alex (Solutions Eng): example mapping we send customers:
```
# BlueGate -> Redwood mapping (pseudo)
blue_resp = {"choices": [{"text": "..."}], "finish_reason": "stop"}
redwood_resp = {"messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": blue_resp.choices[0].text}], "meta": {"finish_reason": blue_resp.finish_reason}}
```

Jon (Infra): we can spin up a dedicated test pool for the POC. need Ironbridge CIDR for VPC peering and a contact for KMS key exchange. ETA for infra prep ~48h after we get CIDR.

Tara (Product): for prompt parity I recommend running our eval suite against their 100 canonical prompts. we can surface tokenization diffs and stop-token mismatches in <24h once they share samples.

Devon (Sales Eng): pricing note — ballpark for hosted with a 100M token/month commit: ~15-20% discount off list; if they need isolation/latency guarantees, propose Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit) — pricing changes there, we can run a TCO for them.

Priya (AE): Ironbridge security team asked for SOC2 scope/SSE details, audit logs, and data at rest/in transit encryption info. do we have a canned doc?

sec-bot: uploaded redwood_security_snapshot.pdf :lock: (uploaded to thread) — includes SOC2, encryption, retention, and redaction details.

Alex (Solutions Eng): also watch out for tokenization edge cases: BlueGate strips trailing newlines in some outputs which changes downstream parsing. ask for 20 representative request/response pairs from them.

Priya (AE): I'll request 20 examples + a sample webhook payload. they also flagged webhook retry semantics (BlueGate retries with 10s backoff). how do we match that?

Jon (Infra): our webhook delivery uses exponential backoff by default; can configure to strictly mimic BlueGate for the POC. staging host created: staging-irb-01. creds in 1Password.

Devon (Sales Eng): if the customer wants on-prem later: lead time ~6-8 weeks for Private deployment. for the POC we can host with data isolation options and an NDA.

Alex (Solutions Eng): one more thing — function calling differences: BlueGate expects `functions` array and returns `function_call` object. we map to our `tool_call` events; shim example: `if blue.function_call: emit tool_call(name=blue.fn, args=blue.args)`

Priya (AE): perfect. I'll send the SOW + security packet and ask for tokenized logs and their top 20 prompts. next sync tomorrow 10am PT. @Alex please bring parity checklist and a short demo of the shim. :thumbsup:

Devon (Sales Eng): pinging pricing ops for a committed quote draft, will attach numbers before tomorrow meeting.

Tara (Product): I'll queue the eval run as soon as we get their 100 prompts and the example logs. should have a first-pass parity report within 24h.

Jon (Infra): provisioning tasks (CIDR, KMS, webhook endpoint) assigned. will update thread when staging is ready.

Priya (AE): thanks everyone — closing loop here.
